approval_required_for: Resolving ambiguous board target discovery, wrapper top, Vivado compute cell, AXI width, or simulator executable when exact evidence does not uniquely identify them.
Any architecture, pipeline, memory-layout, numeric-policy, major template, or DUT-scope change.
Any proposed reopening of operator-leaf or single-transformer-layer modules without a current hash-bound direct core-boundary contradiction.

consumes: exact user-supplied sample-project wrapper and simulation sources
immutable numeric policy, target-model reference, semantic testbench, and DUT weight-binding requirements
executable_actions.on_failure: Keep all board-layer gates blocked; record the concrete missing or ambiguous fact in SACG and request bounded approval if necessary. Do not patch DUT RTL, use a simplified wrapper, or run dependency-skipped downstream tools.
produces: updated exact board-interface structured interpretation with wrapper_top_module
Vivado-cell fact and selected AXI-width binding
identity-bound canonical VCS compile plan and authorized simulator executable record
updated board simulation manifest and source-identity hashes
executable_actions.rationale: Repair the missing structured board-interface interpretation and bind all simulation authority to the exact current user-supplied sample-project wrapper and real Vivado export facts. This is a verification/harness repair, not an RTL correctness claim. If discovery cannot uniquely resolve the wrapper top, Vivado compute cell, AXI width, or executable, stop for bounded approval instead of guessing.

consumes: updated board simulation manifest and source-identity hashes
executable_actions.on_failure: Stop at the earliest failed current-layer gate, route its real tool output through causal repair context, and do not run or promote downstream gates. Reopen a lower layer only if a fresh hash-bound trace directly contradicts its certified invariant.
executable_actions.rationale: Once the exact board contract is repaired and passes discovery, rerun the same board layer in DAG order to establish real AXI/DDR and multilayer pipeline evidence before functional simulation. Existing lower-layer certificates remain reusable and must not be replayed absent a direct contradiction.

consumes: exact wrapper and simulation source hashes
executable_actions.on_failure: Create a current causal repair context from the earliest violated board boundary and return to this repair stage. Do not infer a root cause from a downstream output-frontier symptom, alter numeric tolerance, regenerate expected outputs from RTL, or proceed to backend/board runtime.
executable_actions.rationale: After discovery, multilayer pipeline, and AXI/DDR interface gates pass, execute the exact board VCS simulation and analyzer, then run the remaining current-layer functional, liveness, protocol, DDR roundtrip, and semantic evidence gates. Preserve elastic variable-latency pipeline semantics and distinguish independent AXI/prefetch progress from output-frontier progress.

consumes: updated board-interface identity and canonical compile-plan reports
all executed current board-layer real-tool reports
immutable target-model reference and numeric comparison policy
executable_actions.on_failure: Remain needs_repair at board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system, preserve the contamination barrier, and issue a new bounded causal action. Do not promote to synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime ABI, or board runtime.
executable_actions.rationale: Submit only the newly produced, hash-bound current-layer artifacts to Stage7. Treat prior rejected artifacts and open retry-request artifacts as contaminated diagnostic history until the refined contract passes all required checkers.

observations: case_board_interface_discovery failed as a runtime harness and structured board-target interpretation capability, not as evidence of an RTL operator or connected-kernel defect.
The produced board_source_identity report passed, but it does not establish a valid wrapper_top_module, Vivado cell fact, selected AXI width, or executable compile authority.

case_axi_ddr_interface, VCS functional simulation, diagnostic analysis, deadlock/AXI checks, multilayer checks, and board semantic evidence are not valid executed evidence; most are dependency-skipped, and the available AXI report contains identity/authority binding failures.

The available output-frontier symptom indicates ingress completed while zero output beats were accepted, but it is only board lifecycle-frontier localization evidence. It does not by itself reopen the connected kernel or identify an RTL root cause.
The conditional specialist review was no_split and cannot replace checker or real-tool evidence.

sacg_memory_truth has six open retry requests and fifteen active current-scope contamination barriers. Rejected Stage7 and Stage8 artifacts are usable only as diagnostic context until a refined retry passes and is promoted.

Operator-leaf and single-transformer-layer certificates are live hash-validated lower-layer knowledge, including elastic variable-latency token-pipeline ordering and cross-token overlap; reuse them without replay.
proposed_actions: Repair the board-interface discovery and simulation identity contract using only exact sample-project sources and cited real Vivado export facts; if target discovery remains ambiguous, obtain bounded approval rather than guessing.

After the discovery contract passes, run the current board-layer gates in dependency order, beginning with multilayer pipeline and AXI/DDR interface validation, then execute VCS functional simulation and its causal evidence analyzer.

Use the resulting current hash-bound board trace to localize any earliest violated boundary and apply only a bounded wrapper, loader/harness, runtime, or integration repair. Do not schedule lower-layer revalidation unless the trace directly contradicts a named lower-layer invariant.

Assemble board semantic evidence only from an executed real target-model comparison using the immutable checkpoint/stimulus/numeric policy and complete Transformer-block weight-binding proof; return the result to Stage7 for authoritative checking.
risks: Guessing wrapper_top_module, compute cell, AXI width, simulator executable, or source paths would violate the exact-board integration boundary and contaminate the retry.
Running downstream gates before board-interface discovery and canonical AXI/DD​​R identity binding will create dependency-skipped evidence rather than acceptance evidence.
The frontier stall may be caused by wrapper, lifecycle, scheduler, data-order, AXI/DDR, or integration contracts; no RTL patch is justified before a current direct boundary trace.
No current board-level value, numeric, ordering, liveness, AXI, DDR, output-frontier, or board-scope weight-consumption claim exists.
Changing tolerance, checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, testbench semantics, or wrapper sources would invalidate the repair loop.

constraints: Do not promote to Vivado, bitstream, runtime ABI, or board runtime while current-layer gates fail or are dependency-skipped.
Use the exact user-supplied sample-project wrapper and source hashes; do not substitute a simplified wrapper or guess module, board, cell, or path names.
Bind simulation source identity, Vivado-export compile authority, ordered command authority references, and simulator executable authorization to the same current identity document.
Keep checkpoint, deterministic stimulus, independent target-model reference outputs, numeric policy, tolerance, testbench contract, and wrapper source hashes immutable.
Require complete-scope Transformer-block weight-consumption evidence; exclude embedding/tokenization, final norm, LM head/logits, and sampling from DUT scope.
Do not reopen certified lower layers without a current hash-bound direct core-boundary contradiction.

output.summary: Reject promotion and authorize only a bounded current-layer verification-capability repair. The earliest deterministic failure is exact board-interface discovery: the selector emitted no valid structured interpretation, wrapper_top_module is missing, the selected compute cell is not a Vivado cell fact, and AXI width is unresolved. Rebind the exact user-supplied sample-project wrapper and current Vivado export facts, then rerun the board-layer verification DAG. Certified operator-leaf and connected single-transformer-layer evidence remains reusable; no current hash-bound trace contradicts it, so neither lower layer should be reopened.
